Exercises a filtering LineIterator that rejects lines whose trailing digit is congruent to 1 mod 3 (i.e., lines ending in 1, 4, or 7 are skipped).

With 9 source lines "LINE 0"–"LINE 8", exactly 3 lines are filtered out (LINE 1, LINE 4, LINE 7), so the iterator must yield exactly 6 lines in their original order.
Accepts a line when its last character (a digit) is NOT congruent to 1 mod 3. Lines ending in 1, 4, or 7 are rejected; all others pass through.
sourceIdx tracks our position in the full source list, manually skipping filtered indices (those where sourceIdx % 3 == 1: indices 1, 4, 7).
Advance past the next filtered index (where sourceIdx % 3 == 1)
After exhaustion, next() and nextLine() must both throw NoSuchElementException
